draft.emotion: down-to-earth and wholesome, preparing a hearty meal in a warm kitchen
notes: Usually used in the plural ('ziemniaki') when talking about food. In the singular accusative, it takes the ending '-a' like animate nouns (e.g., 'zjem ziemniaka').
In some regions, you will also hear 'kartofel' or (in Greater Poland) 'pyra'.

senses.definition: A common round underground vegetable with white or yellow flesh.
